_readme: Per-instrument, per-mode spec of the Figma components (file 6SPd7rWzwyvxHhIj4Cmb7a, page 'Stage · Dashboard v1'). Units px. 'box' = [x, y, w, h] relative to the variant's own top-left (outer edge, including the inside stroke). Colours are token names from tokens.json; never use paint-level opacity, use the alpha-baked tokens. Instrument names match svg/<instrument-slug>.<mode>.svg.

conventions.stroke: All panel strokes are INSIDE strokes; Figma auto-layout counts the stroke inside the padding, so content origin = padding + stroke width (compact 10+1 / 8+1, expanded and settings 16+1.6 = 17.6).
conventions.fontKey: font objects: family, style, size (px), optional letterSpacing_px and lineHeight_px (absent = font default line height; Plex line box is about 1.3 x size).
conventions.autoLayout: layout: horizontal | vertical; itemSpacing in px; padding_tRBL = [top, right, bottom, left]. HUG = size from content.
conventions.tokens: fill/stroke given as {token, width} or token string; see tokens.json for hex+alpha.

panelRecipes.compact: HUG both axes; padding 8 top/bottom (spacing/xs) and 10 left/right; itemSpacing 2..6 (stated per node); radius 8; fill color/fill/panel-wash (#5b6b7d at 14%); 1 px inside stroke color/line/hairline (cream at 55%); backdrop blur 12 px (CSS: backdrop-filter: blur(12px) — Figma BACKGROUND_BLUR radius 12; the CSS blur radius is about half: blur(6px) is what Figma's own SVG export emits). Label text Mono 11 ls0.4 color/text/muted.
panelRecipes.expanded: fixed width 640, height hugs content; padding 16; itemSpacing 8; radius 10; fill color/fill/glass (#14263a at 88%); 1.6 px inside stroke color/line/hairline (= stroke/chart weight); no backdrop blur on expanded or settings (glass alpha .88 over the map).
panelRecipes.settings: fixed width 560; same chrome as expanded; header with close control + three rows (SOURCE LINE, UNITS, LOG TEXT); see settingsTemplate.

richText.why: The Figma Plugin API has no baseline shift, so subscripts are separate text nodes.
richText.recipe: A text with an underscore subscript is a horizontal auto-layout row (hugging, or wrapping when the original was a fill-width paragraph) whose children are words. A word containing a subscript is a nested row: base text node(s) + a subscript text node. All nodes share fill token and family/style. Subscript node: font size = round(0.7 x base size), explicit lineHeight = round(0.8 x subscript size); both rows bottom-align their children (counterAxisAlignItems MAX), so the shorter line box lowers the subscript baseline by about 0.2 x base size. Words are separated by itemSpacing (0.26 x size for Plex Sans, 0.6 x size for Plex Mono; plus letterSpacing for spaced labels) because Figma trims trailing spaces; no space characters are stored.
richText.reactRecipe: ρτ with sub { fontSize: .7em; verticalAlign: baseline; position: relative; top: .2em; lineHeight: 0 } reproduces the geometry; runs[] in each richText node give the exact pixel boxes to compare against.
richText.subscriptRuns: ρ_τ, Φ_load, ψ_m, ψ_s, jψ_s, O_racialized. Settings strings use _{...} markers for the same runs. Identifier underscores (dashboard_eras.json, fields.system_stress ...) are NOT subscripts.

settingsTemplate.rowRecipe: each row = vertical stack gap 8: label (Mono 12 ls0.6 color/text/muted, 16 px tall) then a well (fill color/surface/well, radius 6, padding top/bottom 8, left/right 10) holding the wrapped value text at the full 524.8-4... inner width 504.8; well height = 16 + lines * lineHeight (Mono 13 -> 17 px/line, Sans 16 -> 21 px/line); rows separated by 16

content.title: SETTINGS · BACKLASH OSCILLATOR
content.source: eq. 1.7a · L q̈ + R q̇ + q/C = V(t)
content.units: q(t): equality-surplus charge · t: years from the shock · R friction, L inertia, C absorption
content.log: The manuscript’s series RLC circuit (eq. 1.7a): a reform shock V(t) displaces the equality-surplus charge q(t) above the extraction baseline, and the circuit’s reactive parts pull it back past zero into backlash. R is bureaucratic and carceral friction, L is cultural inertia, and C is token-reform absorption capacity.
